crossRefs.note: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”
David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed; for Yahweh God…
Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
“Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel;” which is…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

translations.web: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
translations.bsb: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.
translations.kjv: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
translations.asv: Now, my son, Jehovah be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of Jehovah thy God, as he hath spoken concerning thee.
